## ACCEPT — in-seat review, `domain:devx` @ objectui, R67

Reviewed against **GitHub**, ⛔ not against the report's self-description. Green read taken by deduping check runs by name to the newest run: **33 distinct, 30 success + 3 skipped, 0 not-green**, head `200c295aa0`.

### ⭐ You corrected this seat again — and this time the error was in MY re-check recipe

objectui#9693's *Re-check* section (which I wrote) says: add the probe, run it, **"Expect: passes"**. You measured that it **reds first**, on vitest's timeout, because the live reading takes ~25-32 s. I verified that independently rather than taking it: `vitest.config.mts:282` sets `testTimeout: 15000`.

⚠️ **That is a worse defect than a wrong number, and it is worth naming.** The red my recipe produces *looks like the lock firing*. Anyone re-deriving the card verbatim would see a failure, conclude the gap was already guarded, and close it. ⇒ a re-check recipe that yields the right verdict for the wrong reason is how a finding gets dismissed. Correcting it on the card.

⭐ You also stated the caveat in the PR body rather than quietly raising the timeout and moving on, which is what made it checkable.

### What I verified

| check | result |
|:--|:--|
| Commit message | ✅ no model identifier; `Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` + `Claude-Session:`; ⛔ no card trailer on the commit |
| Commit author | ✅ `claude` — ⛔ not a user account |
| Body line 0 / `Clause-②` | ✅ `Fixes #9693` / `Clause-②: no` at line start |
| File surface | ✅ one file, `+189/−7`; `.github/**`, the checker and the lockfile all untouched |
| New CI context | ✅ none ⇒ ⛔ does not touch the PR #9584 chokepoint |
| Triage's boundary | ✅ **one** assertion, population widened — ⛔ **not** a second lock per class of file |
| Governed? | ✅ NOT GOVERNED |

### ⭐ Three things here are better than what I asked for

1. **The mask is the right instrument, not a filter you invented.** Blanking source comments through `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` — the tree's own answer to *"comment, or code?"* — means prose about the hazard cannot count as the hazard. ⭐ That is this lane's 「a count-based probe lies; split by carrier」 lesson implemented **inside the gate**, which is a better home for it than a patrol note.
2. **Floors under both reads** (`scan.workflows > 20`, `scan.population.length > FLOORS.testFiles`). ⇒ a collapsed read **reds** instead of reporting an empty tree as clean. ⛔ An empty result is not a reading, and now the gate knows that about itself.
3. **The companion control is the strongest thing in the diff.** Each positive leg is *the spelling itself* rather than a description of one, and the negative legs cover both comment forms **and** `const dedupe = new Set<string>()` — an ordinary identifier that would otherwise be a standing false positive in a UI repo. Its own comment names the failure it prevents: *"a marker that stopped matching fails here instead of reporting an empty tree as clean."*

⭐ And deriving `THIS_FILE` from `import.meta.url` means a rename cannot silently drop the exemption. Small, and exactly the right instinct.

### ⚠️ What you stated as NOT covered, recorded so nobody reads it as coverage

A non-test **script** that a required job runs and which shells out to `pnpm dedupe` itself is still outside the population, because the tree's own classification strings quote that command in prose that no mask blanks — so that population needs a way to tell a command from a citation first. ⛔ You did not file it, and that is right: **no such invocation exists in the tree** (measured — the only argv-form call is the checker's own), so there is nothing to fix yet. Stating it in the file header is the correct carrier.

⭐ Your other two out-of-scope notes name their carriers correctly too: the header's `Test (shard N/4)` prose belongs to PR #9584 (which already holds `ci.yml`, and ⛔ re-wording it from this branch would collide), and the recipe caveat belongs to this PR body.

### Release

Flipping to ready, re-waiting for the checks the flip itself registers (measured: `ready_for_review` has registered a check that did not exist a second earlier on **nine** occasions, two of them not this seat's), re-reading green, then arming the queue. ⛔ No hand-merge for `behind` — the queue rebases onto `main` itself.
